self-assessment-cost.question: How much does a self-assessment return cost?
self-assessment-cost.answer: Self-assessment returns start from £250 for straightforward employment income plus one property or freelance source. The exact price depends on your income sources — I'll give you a fixed quote upfront before any work begins.

outside-london.question: Do you work outside London?
outside-london.answer: Yes. I'm based in London and happy to meet clients in person in the city. For clients elsewhere in the UK, I work entirely remotely via video call, email, and cloud accounting software — with no difference in service quality.

qualified-accountant.question: Are you a qualified accountant?
qualified-accountant.answer: Yes. I'm a UK Chartered Accountant (ACA) and a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW) — the gold standard of UK accountancy qualifications.

making-tax-digital.question: What is Making Tax Digital and does it affect me?
making-tax-digital.answer: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax Self-Assessment (MTD for ITSA) requires sole traders and landlords to keep digital records and submit quarterly updates to HMRC. It applies from 6 April 2026 if your income exceeds £50,000; April 2027 for over £30,000; April 2028 for over £20,000. I can get you fully prepared.

vat-registration.question: When do I need to register for VAT?
vat-registration.answer: You must register for VAT when your taxable turnover exceeds £90,000 in any rolling 12-month period (unchanged since 1 April 2024). You can also register voluntarily below this threshold, which can be beneficial in some cases. I can advise on whether voluntary registration makes sense for your business.

fixed-fees.question: How do fixed fees work?
fixed-fees.answer: Before any work begins, I give you a clear, all-inclusive fixed price for the service you need. That price doesn't change unless your circumstances change significantly. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices at the end of the year.

accounting-software.question: Which accounting software do you use?
accounting-software.answer: I work with all major cloud platforms: Xero, QuickBooks, FreeAgent, and Sage. If you don't have software yet, I'll recommend the best fit for your business type and budget. All are MTD-compatible.

response-time.question: How quickly do you respond?
response-time.answer: I aim to respond to all enquiries within one business day. For existing clients with urgent questions, you can reach me directly by phone or WhatsApp and I'll do my best to help promptly.
